parameters.content:
## 1. Settings and memory
One Settings node controls the whole run. Past jobs are read from Google Sheets so duplicates are skipped.

## 2. Seven free job feeds
Each source retries and is skipped if it fails, so one outage never stops the run.

## 3. Normalize, filter, dedupe, AI score
One schema, seniority and keyword filters, then Gemini scores each job with a rubric and returns structured JSON.

## 4. Store and report
All scored jobs go to Sheets. A daily report with statistics and cover letters is emailed.
